notes: pnpm everywhere: README, CI (pnpm/action-setup 12.3.4), pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm-workspace.yaml (packages/api-client, packages/mcp). package.json engines.pnpm is pinned to exactly 12.3.4, and pnpm refuses to install with any other version. The README only documents a production-style install (pnpm run build, then pnpm run start). The build runs check:env, prisma generate, check:db (connects to the DB and applies migrations, which create the admin/umami login), tracker/recorder/geo/openapi builds, workspace packages and next build. For development, `pnpm dev` (dotenv next dev --turbo) is in package.json but not in any doc. It needs at least the generated Prisma client and a migrated DB, so in practice run `pnpm run build` once, or `pnpm build:db && pnpm db:migrate`. Node: the README says 18.18+, but packages/mcp engines require >=20, CI and the Dockerfile use 22, and Next 16 needs >=20.9, so the README is stale. Postgres version: the README says v12.14+, check-db.js enforces >=9.4, docker-compose uses postgres:15. The root docker-compose.yml runs the published image plus Postgres (a deployment setup, not dev). APP_SECRET is recommended (falls back to a hash of DATABASE_URL). REDIS_URL/CLICKHOUSE_URL are only needed for cloud mode.
